name: thermal-dial
title: Thermal Dial
description: A thermal dial that undulates with heat and rolls through the seasons.
docs:
Thermal Dial — A thermal dial that undulates with heat and rolls through the seasons.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Manrope (500 and 800), with Inter for the hint — the site exposes Manrope as --font-manrope, and the stylesheet falls back to a face named "Manrope". If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans and look noticeably different.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.
